contents.Header: Overview of Each UI Element ≈ Left to Right

contents.Text: Starts music playback, then pause/unpause afterwards.
Stops all music and clears the queue.
Skips the current song.
Toggles [[[strong:repeat]]], cycling through: [[[strong:Off]]] (default) → [[[strong:Repeat Once]]] → [[[strong:Infinite Repeat]]]
Toggles the Music Player Settings.
Each setting is explained on the [[[button:Music Player Settings][Music Player Settings]]] page.
This is the body where songs will be added to via:
This button opens a UI to [[[strong:rate]]] the song.
Choose a number to save the [[[strong:rating]]] both to the [[[strong:database]]] and embed it in the song file.
Click a previously selected number to [[[strong:remove]]] the rating.

[[[warning:Note:]]] The selected number will briefly turn [[[strong:yellow]]] to indicate it is being saved. During this time, [[[strong:any additional clicks]]] will be ignored. Once saving is complete, the number will change to the user defined colour.
The volume slider is the first of the two sliders. It starts in the middle, at the default volume level of 1.0.
Moving the slider [[[strong:down]]] decreases the volume, and sliding it [[[strong:up]]] increases the volume.

rows: Default volume level (the middle of the slider)

contents.Text: [[[warning:Note:]]] [[[strong:Clipping]]] is a risk with the higher settings, as they amplify quiet songs.
The speed slider is the second slider, to the right of the volume slider. It adjusts the [[[strong:playback speed]]] of the music.
[[[warning:Note:]]] This slider is only shown when [[[strong:Enable Speed Control]]] is ticked on the [[[button:Music Player Settings][Music Player Settings]]] page.
This is the state where the playback bar is closed. It features a button labelled [[[strong:Seek]]] that opens the playback bar for further interaction.
The UI in the [[[strong:Non-Refresh State]]] includes several components:

rows: Closes the UI and returns to the [[[strong:Closed State]]]
Seeks to the [[[strong:time]]] set on the slider or in the text input

contents.Text: [[[strong:Close Button:]]] [[[strong:Right-clicking]]] it transitions to the [[[strong:Continuous Refresh State]]] UI. Clicking it and reopening the [[[strong:Seek]]] button will set the slider to the current playback time.
[[[strong:Slider:]]] The time is displayed in [[[strong:hh:mm:ss]]] format. Users can also input time directly into a small box next to the slider, in various formats:
[[[warning:Note:]]] This is currently the [[[strong:default state]]] of the playback bar when it is opened.
The [[[strong:Continuous Refresh State]]] mirrors the [[[strong:Non-Refresh State]]] but without the Go Button.
Each [[[strong:adjustment]]] to the slider is applied immediately, providing real-time feedback.
[[[warning:Note:]]] This mode may consume slightly more [[[strong:CPU]]] resources, as it refreshes the screen with each slider movement.
